source_title: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements and Endorsements for Misleading Advertisements, 2022
instrument_type: CCPA guidelines under section 18 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019
update_check: Official Department of Consumer Affairs Acts index and CCPA guideline listings checked on retrieval date. This is a frozen limited reference, not a continuously updated law service.
supported_scope: Selected English outcome, time-bound and absolute-performance advertising claims; general substantiation review only.
unsupported_scope: Sector-specific regulation (including coaching, healthcare and finance), other jurisdictions/languages, general truth, metaphor, disclaimer typography, all consumer law and legal certification.

disabled_packs.reason: Final instrument linked by PIB could not be retrieved from the official document host. No unverified clause is activated. General 2022 substantiation review remains available with partial sector coverage.

rules.interpretation: Objectively testable advertising claims need supporting evidence. A matched promise requests review; it does not prove falsity or a legal breach.
rules.review_action: Record the evidence reference, applicable audience, outcome definition, conditions and time period. Edit unsupported promises and rerun. A generic disclaimer does not automatically resolve the concern.
